task: At the end of local calendar day t-1, predict the total recorded dispatch energy during day t; assume t-1 telemetry is complete and available. This is a retrospective one-day-ahead rolling-input forecast with frozen parameters, not a fixed-origin multi-step forecast.
dataset: Zenodo 17175212 version 1, Sri Lankan raw PUCSL dispatch subset
target: Sum deduplicated plant MW at each 15-minute timestamp, multiply by 0.25 hours and sum over local calendar day, in MWh
quality_rules: Convert UTC to Asia/Colombo before aggregation
Drop identical timestamp/plant duplicate keys and fail on conflicting values
Require exactly 96 distinct 15-minute timestamps per target day
Exclude target days with any explicit missing plant value
Retain small negative readings as potential net station use; evaluate their aggregate impact
Retain zero readings and unexplained extremes; do not remove difficult test days
Do not infer absent plants are verified zero; target is observed dispatch, not national end-use consumption
feature_rules: All demand features are shifted by at least one day; rolling statistics use only t-7 through t-1. Reindex daily before shifting; drop rows with missing required features rather than interpolating targets. Calendar features describe known target date. Scaling fitted inside every training fold.
selection_metric: Unweighted mean of the three fold MAEs, MWh; lower is better
report_metrics: MAE skill versus lag7 seasonal naive

GPR.signal: ConstantKernel * (RBF or Matern nu=1.5 or Matern nu=2.5)

predeclared_diagnostics: GPR retrain ablations excluding calendar/trend or excluding demand history, using the selected kernel with no retuning
Repeat RF final fit with seeds 7,42,2026 and GPR optimized fit with initial length-scale multipliers 0.5,1,2; do not choose a new model using test scores
95% Gaussian predictive observation interval coverage, mean width, mean Gaussian negative log predictive density
Paired moving-block bootstrap MAE differences against seasonal naive and the best taught comparator selected on CV; 2000 replicates, block length 7 with sensitivity 14
Grouped permutation importance of demand history, weekly calendar and annual/trend with 20 random 7-day block permutations, seed 42
Local signed group-replacement explanations relative to training medians, labelled non-additive and non-causal
Worst errors, month and weekday/weekend slices, residual autocorrelation
test_policy: No model choice, tuning, feature redesign or interval recalibration after observing held-out metrics. Diagnostics are descriptive; all configurations and failures retained.
compute: Local CPU; numerical thread limit 1; no Azure resources
implementation_notes_before_fit: Grouped permutation uses shuffled contiguous seven-day blocks followed by a random 0-6-day circular phase shift; this avoids invariant weekday encodings when blocks align on weekdays.

Local group replacement uses the actual development row nearest to the standardized median vector, preserving valid cyclic coordinates within groups; simple coordinate-wise calendar medians can be infeasible. These non-additive sensitivity explanations are not SHAP.
